reason: I get most of my leads from posting and comment-to-DM, and I only cold DM when the pipeline is thin, so I'm not going to add $147 a month for a tool I'd use part of the time. I can't justify another subscription until I land the next client.
objection: No results from anyone yet, and it needs a card up front with payments final after day 3. If I forget to cancel or it doesn't produce replies, I've lost $147 on a tool I barely needed.
would_change_my_mind: A few real customers showing replies and booked calls from it, or a trial with no card required. Even then I'd likely wait until I have a client paying for it.
